items.content_html: This vulnerability is of the "double-free" type, which occurs during the processing of key exchange (KEX) algorithms in OpenSSH. A "double-free" vulnerability happens when memory that has already been freed is freed again. This issue can indirectly lead to remote code execution (RCE) by an attacker.
